scope: Three isolated protocol-regression fixtures. Initial bad plans are deliberately injected, not mistakes made by the current model. Prior measured evidence is replayed; no new physical simulation. All participants and the no-peer control see identical evidence. Do not aggregate the three role pairs into proof for one contest task.

cases.action_spec: Return action {candidate: candidate_id}. Choose minimum elapsed_sim_s among candidates whose queue increase is <=5 percent, then minimum mean_queue. Exact objective ties are equally acceptable.

evidence.note: Four-row subset of previously measured nine-candidate results; this is not a new search benchmark.
